stem_en: Given below are two statements: Statement I: A unit formed by the attachment of a base to 1' position of sugar is known as nucleoside. Statement II: When nucleoside is linked to phosphorous acid at 5'-position of sugar moiety, we get nucleotide. In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

statements.label: Statement I
statements.text: A unit formed by the attachment of a base to 1' position of sugar is known as nucleoside.

statements.label: Statement II
statements.text: When nucleoside is linked to phosphorous acid at 5'-position of sugar moiety, we get nucleotide.

options_en.1: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_en.2: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
options_en.3: Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
options_en.4: Statement I is false but Statement II is true.
